# Graph operations · kernel

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### kernel.acoustic-wave-network.v1

Run a branched pressure/volume-flow network at a fixed sample rate.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `config` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `commands` | `array<record>` | `[]` | Model input commands with tick, input, and value. · {"items":"record"} · {"drive":{"type":"number","default":0}} |
| Input | `clock` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"tick":{"type":"number","unit":"model tick"},"dt":{"type":"number","unit":"s"},"seed":{"type":"number"},"blockSize":{"type":"number","unit":"samples","min":1,"max":65536}} |
| Input | `checkpoint` | `record` | `{}` | Portable world checkpoint from the same kernel configuration and input schedule. · {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `pressure` | `number` | — | {"unit":"Pa"} · {"finite":true} |
| Output | `flow` | `number` | — | {"unit":"m^3/s"} · {"finite":true} |
| Output | `checkpoint` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe kernel.acoustic-wave-network.v1 --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
